body:
1. Fix lib/digest.mjs win32 executable bit simulation so package/bin/cli.mjs (0644) stays class f on Windows and matches STAGED_ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_TREE_DIGESTS[1.7.0]. Add regression test in test/digest.test.mjs.
2. Update .gitattributes to enforce eol=lf on text/dist/vendor/adlc and binary on vendor/cache/*.tgz.
3. Fix defaultUninstallerArgv in lib/migrate.mjs on win32 to invoke process.execPath on dist/agb.mjs instead of /bin/sh.
4. Use npm.cmd + shell:true on win32 in scripts/update-adlc-digests.mjs.
title: Wave 1: Resolve Windows digest blocker, line-ending attributes, and Windows uninstaller/pack paths
